AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: This app provides public transport information for the Lille metropolitan area (Ilévia network: bus, tram, metro) and V'Lille bike share. Answers are in French. Operational Patterns: - Stop, station and direction names are matched ignoring case and accents; part of a name is enough, and spelling or speech recognition mistakes are tolerated. - For a position, use 'autourDeMoi' to find nearby stops with their lines, then 'prochainsPassages' for the departures at one of them. - Call 'listerFavoris' before 'favori' to get the exact favorite names. - Each answer has 'text', ready to be read aloud, and 'json', the same answer as structured data. Constraints: - Read-only: no function changes data or settings. - The metro only has scheduled times; bus and tram times are real-time when the Ilévia feed allows it. - When several stops match equally (ambiguous_stop), the error lists them: ask the user to choose.
